input: same retained PostgreSQL/Debezium Kafka topics, 1M default orders/10k customers; corrections, source hard deletes and cancellations; quiescent source with application mutation grants revoked
source_fence: full ordered source SHA256 plus durable parent source receipts and captured topic end offsets; fingerprint must remain unchanged across serial backend phases

doris.state: Unique Key merge-on-write, source composite revision, prejoined Flink results

clickhouse.state: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree by source ID/LSN, query-time FINAL and current customer join
clickhouse.raw: full Debezium envelopes plus native topic/partition/offset; at least once ingestion, no skipped broken records

correctness: all eight fields match source; direct full reads from every data replica, native healthy/current membership; conflicting payload/version ties and ambiguous partial batches fail
atomicity: no cross-topic join transaction; eventual settled-state contract at the source fence; witness INSERT is eight rows in one partition/block, independently reconciled
deletes: native full before-image plus newer source LSN; retain tombstones, filter after replacement; no unsafe cleanup
failure: separate serving-role SIGKILL while independent queries and new direct quorum witness writes run; acknowledged batches survive on all three replicas after retained-node recovery

witness.identity: unique UUID/sequence; external fsynced intents/ACKs; unresolved commits remain ambiguous

unrun: CDC ingestion interruption under fresh source mutations
